end_restore_monsoon.title: Ending 1: The Great Release
end_restore_monsoon.epilogue: You break the great seals of the Weather Vault above the arid plains. Thousands of captured clouds rise into the sky, unleashing torrential life-giving rains across the continent.

end_sky_sanctuary.title: Ending 2: The Island in the Clouds
end_sky_sanctuary.epilogue: You steer Lumi's airship into the heart of the permanent cumulus eye, discovering the floating botanical haven kept secret from the barons of the ground.
